# Portmaster Assist // Code of Conduct

## Our main motto

"*Please be respectful and constructive, always treat others as you would want them treating you...*".

## Acceptable behavior

* Constructive feedback and/or criticism.
  * Just remember: play the (foot)ball, not the person.
* Technical discussions.
  * Be honest, be open: when it sucks... it sucks.
* Bug reports.
* Feature suggestions.

## What we **won't** tolerate and/or appreciate...

* Harassment.
* Personal attacks.
* Spam.
* Unproductive and endless discussions about the use of AI.
  * Also see our [AI usage disclaimer](https://github.com/ShelLuser/portmaster-assist/wiki/DISCLAIMER).
* Discussions about open source licenses.

My project is maintained in the spirit of collaboration and mutual respect.
